---
title: "Big Timestamp Player"
toc: false
---

```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="player.css">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="player-log.css">
<style>
/* player.css is tuned for a reveal.js slide, where everything scales with the
   deck. This is an ordinary page, so the component is given a base size of its
   own -- and the clock the size the thing is named for. */
.btp { font-size: 1.25rem; margin: 1.5rem 0 3rem; }
.btp .btp-clock { font-size: clamp(3rem, 11vw, 7rem); }
.btp .btp-stage,
.btp .btp-drop,
.btp .btp-bar { max-width: 900px; }
</style>

<button class="btp-nav-toggle" type="button">« Hide menu</button>

<div class="btp-layout">

<div class="btp">
  <div class="btp-clock idle">00:00</div>
  <div class="btp-stage" hidden></div>
  <div class="btp-drop">Drop a video file here</div>
  <div class="btp-bar">
    <input class="btp-url" type="text" placeholder="Paste a YouTube link…" spellcheck="false">
    <button class="btp-load">Load</button>
    <label class="btp-filebtn">Choose file<input class="btp-file" type="file" accept="video/*"></label>
  </div>
  <div class="btp-err"></div>
</div>

<section class="btp-log">
  <h2>Timestamps</h2>
  <p class="btp-log-note"><kbd>C</kbd> stamps the time and copies it.
     <kbd>Return</kbd> plays and pauses. Leave a note with <kbd>Esc</kbd>
     or <kbd>jk</kbd>.</p>
  <label class="btp-autonote-label">
    <input class="btp-autonote" type="checkbox" checked>
    Jump to the note field after a stamp
  </label>
  <ol class="btp-log-rows"></ol>
  <p class="btp-log-empty">Nothing stamped yet.</p>
  <div class="btp-log-buttons">
    <button class="btp-stamp-now" type="button">Stamp now</button>
    <button class="btp-copy-all" type="button">Copy all</button>
    <button class="btp-download" type="button">Download .txt</button>
    <button class="btp-clear" type="button">Clear</button>
  </div>
</section>

</div>

<script src="player.js"></script>
<script src="player-log.js"></script>
```
